title: Multidimensional Bayesian Active Machine Learning of Working Memory Task Performance
abstract: arXiv:2510.00375v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While adaptive experimental design has outgrown one-dimensional, staircase-based adaptations, most cognitive experiments still control a single factor and summarize performance with a scalar. In contrast, we validate here a Bayesian, two-axis, active-classification approach in an immersive virtual testing environment, using a 5-by-5 spatial working-memory reconstruction task as an application domain. Two variables are controlled: spatial load L (number of occupied tiles) and feature-binding load K (number of distinct colors) of items. Stimulus acquisition is guided by posterior uncertainty of a nonparametric Gaussian Process (GP) probabilistic classifier, which outputs a surface over (L, K) rather than a single threshold or maximum span value. In a young adult population, we compare GP-driven Adaptive Mode (AM) with a traditional adaptive staircase Classic Mode (CM), which varies L only at K = 3. Parity between the methods is achieve

translated_title: 工作记忆任务表现的多维贝叶斯主动机器学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2510.00375v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：尽管适应性实验设计已经超越了一维的、基于阶梯式的自适应方法，但大多数认知实验仍然只控制单一因素，并用标量来总结表现。相比之下，我们在此验证了一种贝叶斯双轴主动分类方法，应用于沉浸式虚拟测试环境中，并以5×5空间工作记忆重建任务作为应用领域。该方法控制两个变量：空间负荷L（被占用的方格数量）和项目的特征绑定负荷K（不同颜色的数量）。刺激采集由非参数高斯过程（GP）概率分类器的后验不确定性引导，该分类器输出的是关于空间上的一个曲面，而非单一阈值或最大广度值。在年轻成年人群体中，我们将GP驱动的自适应模式与传统自适应阶梯式的经典模式进行比较，后者仅在K=3时改变L。两种方法达到了相当的水平……
tldr: 该研究提出一种基于高斯过程后验不确定性的双轴贝叶斯主动分类方法，在沉浸式虚拟环境中同时控制空间负荷与特征绑定负荷两个维度来评估工作记忆表现，其效果与传统单维阶梯式自适应方法相当。
en_tdlr: This study validates a Bayesian two-axis active-classification approach driven by Gaussian Process posterior uncertainty, which simultaneously controls spatial load and feature-binding load in an immersive virtual working-memory task, achieving parity with traditional single-factor adaptive staircase methods.
